lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Transporting Cargo, Safety Chains & Towing Laws
prompt: How does pulling a heavy trailer or boat affect vehicle handling and stopping distance?

options.text: Decreases stopping distance because trailer weight adds ground tire grip
Has zero impact on braking or handling provided trailer has small wheels
Significantly increases stopping distance and causes swaying at higher speeds
Allows passenger vehicles to accelerate faster onto freeway entrance ramps
